title: Model catalog defaults: automated per-model quant profiles with safety guardrails
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers need reliable per-model quantization defaults surfaced in the model catalog (recommended profile + explicit guardrails) so that developers can pick safe, cost-effective options without manual tuning. Current ad-hoc defaults lead to either excessive cost (always FP16/FP32) or silent accuracy regressions (unvalidated INT8).

Goal: Build an automated calibration + validation pipeline that runs at model onboarding and periodically for model updates, and publish a per-model default quant profile with rationale and a set of runtime guardrail rules (fallback thresholds, rollout gates, and conservative defaults).

Scope: implement calibration job templates (FP8/INT8/INT4 as applicable), a standardized validation suite (perplexity / downstream evals / user-defined eval sets), a scoring rubric that maps delta metrics to recommended default and guardrail settings, and model-catalog metadata fields (default_profile, fallback_profile, validation_snapshot). Deliverables: calibration pipeline, PRD for catalog metadata schema, migration of top 20 models to new defaults, runtime enforcement hooks for guardrails (reject or degrade to fallback), docs for SRE/Support.

Acceptance criteria: 1) Every model in the onboarding queue runs automated calibration and returns a recommended default. 2) For top-20 production models we show before/after cost x quality numbers and confidence score. 3) Runtime guardrail policies are able to redirect requests to fallback profile when quality drift or hardware mismatch is detected. 4) UX in catalog displays recommended profile + short justification and link to validation artifacts.
updates: 2025-02-12: Ticket created after engineering/ML sync. Asha drafted initial PRD and shared with Runtime and Catalog owners.
2025-02-18: Prototype calibration job implemented on staging (k8s + batch). Ran FP8 and INT8 calibration for 'redwood-7b-open', stored quant tensors and calibration traces.

2025-02-20: Early validation results: 'redwood-7b-open' FP8 shows +0.4% relative downstream accuracy vs baseline FP16; INT8 shows -2.3% on conversational eval suite. Decided to prefer FP8 as default and mark INT8 as 'experimental' with guardrail requiring per-customer opt-in and canary rollout.

2025-02-25: Design review with Catalog + Console teams. Agreed on two new metadata fields: default_quant_profile, fallback_quant_profile, and a validation_snapshot_url. Console team to show a short one-line justification and link to snapshot.
2025-02-27: PR opened: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4521 implementing calibration runner and result schema. Running full calibration on top-20 models (estimate 3 days on staging fleet).

2025-03-03: Added basic runtime guardrail prototype: when validation_score falls below threshold, requests are routed to fallback_profile. Need to add telemetry alerts and SLO mapping. Next: finalize scoring rubric and add per-model thresholds in catalog.

Review notes: PM (María González) requested clearer user-visible language for "experimental" profiles and a migration plan for Dedicated customers. Design (Evan Brooks) asked for inline links to calibration artifacts. Ops (Jonas Meyer) raised concern about calibration job GPU cost — propose spot preemptible runs + caching of calibration traces.
qa_plan: 1) Run calibration pipeline for each model in staging and capture validation_snapshot. 2) Execute downstream evals (conversational, summarization, retrieval-augmented) and compute delta against baseline FP16. 3) Run synthetic traffic through runtime guardrail (simulate drift/hardware mismatch) and verify fallback routing and alerting. 4) Smoke test catalog UI for metadata display and link resolution.
validation_results: redwood-7b-open: FP8 recommended (delta +0.4% on conv-eval; latency -18%; cost -34%); INT8 experimental (delta -2.3%) -> fallback=FP16, guardrail: block INT8 in Hosted by default.
redwood-13b-v2: FP8 candidate shows small accuracy drop (delta -0.8%) but cost improvements; scoring gives medium confidence -> default=FP16 with optional FP8 canary and "requires-canary" flag.
redwood-70b-qlora: INT8 incompatible in current quant pipeline (instability in KV cache), default remains FP16; follow-up action: kernel fixes in runtime to attempt INT8 next quarter.
open-llama-3b: INT8 stable (delta -0.1%), set default=INT8 and fallback=FP16, add runtime guardrail threshold 1.5% absolute degrade.
notes: all numbers reported on standardized eval suite (n=50k tokens) and include variance bands; operator should consult detailed snapshot for per-task deltas.
next_steps: Finalize scoring rubric (weighting between downstream delta, perplexity, and calibration trace stability).
Add automated migration proposal for Dedicated customers and opt-in channels for experimental profiles.
Hook telemetry: expose validation_score, default_profile, and fallback_profile in per-model metrics dashboard.
Complete migration of top-20 models and prepare release notes for runtime-1.20.
Schedule security / compliance review for Private deployments using experimental quant profiles.
